description: A vertically stacked set of collapsible sections — hairline rows with a chevron that flips open→closed (WAI-ARIA Accordion pattern).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `value`.
Value of the item expanded on first render. A single value even in
`multiple` mode — uncontrolled accordions can seed only one open item;
pass controlled {@link AccordionRootControlledProps.value`value`} to
start with several. Omit to start with everything collapsed.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Reading direction; see {@link AccordionReadingDirection}. In `"rtl"` the
horizontal arrow keys are mirrored. Also set as the container's `dir`
attribute. Inherited from the nearest {@link DirectionProvider } when
omitted, falling back to `"ltr"`.

props.name: multiple
props.description:
Allow more than one section to be expanded at a time. When `false`,
opening an item collapses whichever item was previously open.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the complete next array of expanded values whenever the user
toggles an item.
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Layout axis, controlling arrow-key navigation: `"vertical"` binds
ArrowUp/ArrowDown, `"horizontal"` binds ArrowLeft/ArrowRight. Surfaces as
`data-orientation` on the root.

props.name: value
props.description:
The full set of currently expanded item values. Must be kept in sync by
the parent via `onValueChange`. In single (`multiple={false}`) mode this
holds at most one value.
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — use `defaultValue`.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Control size for the whole widget; `data-density` scales each size further.

props.name: children
props.description:
Section contents — typically an {@link AccordionHeaderProps`Accordion.Header`}
+ {@link AccordionContentProps`Accordion.Content`} pair.

props.name: value
props.description:
Stable identifier matched against the root's expanded set (and against
`value` / `defaultValue`). When omitted, a stable id is generated via
`useId()` — fine for anonymous items whose state is never driven from
outside.

props.name: level
props.description:
Heading level to render (`h1`–`h6`). Choose the level that fits the
surrounding document outline — the WAI-ARIA Accordion pattern requires
each trigger to be wrapped in a heading at the right level.

props.name: children
props.description:
Trigger label / contents — the visible section heading text, plus an
optional {@link AccordionTriggerIconProps`Accordion.TriggerIcon`}.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the consumer's own element instead of a `<button>`, merging all
accordion ARIA attributes, event handlers, and the ref onto it via the
{@link Slot } pattern. When combined with `disabled`, `role="button"` is
injected so `aria-disabled` is valid on non-button children.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Disable the trigger. Rendered as `aria-disabled` / `data-disabled`
rather than the native `disabled` attribute, so the button stays
focusable (discoverable by keyboard) but is excluded from arrow-key
navigation and cannot be activated.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Ref to the rendered element. Defaults to `HTMLButtonElement`; when using
`asChild`, specify the child's element type (e.g. `HTMLAnchorElement`).

props.name: children
props.description: Panel contents, revealed when the matching trigger is expanded.

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keep the panel mounted in the DOM even while collapsed (instead of
removing it from view with the `hidden` attribute), so CSS open/close
transitions can run. While closed it receives `aria-hidden="true"` so
assistive tech still ignores it; drive visibility yourself via
`[data-state="closed"]`.

props.name: children
props.description:
Icon contents — an inline `<svg>` or any icon component. Rendered inside
an `aria-hidden` `<span>` carrying a `data-state` open/close hook.

api.description:
`<primitiv-accordion>` — the state owner of a WAI-ARIA accordion.

The root finds its own items, so an accordion nested in a panel keeps its own, and reconciles every part's ARIA from its reflected state whenever a part arrives, leaves, or changes an attribute the root reads (the lifecycle is `PrimitivRootElement`'s). `multiple` is read live at each toggle, so a change to it needs no reconcile.

Each trigger sits in a heading you write (`<h3>`, at the level the page's outline needs): a real heading element is the header, so there is no element for it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The open items' values, separated by spaces. Reflected: it changes as the user toggles items, so a server re-render or a history snapshot sees what is open. Item values therefore cannot contain whitespace.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Lets more than one item be open at once. Without it, opening an item closes the open one.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout axis, which picks the arrow-key pair. Defaults to `vertical`.

events.name: primitiv-accordion-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven toggle is applied, with every item open afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.

api.description: `<primitiv-accordion-item>` — one collapsible section. Structural: it pairs a trigger and a panel and carries the value the root's `value` lists.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The item's value, listed in the root's `value` while it is open. No whitespace.

api.description: `<primitiv-accordion-trigger>` — an interactive part. It decorates exactly one child the consumer writes, a `<button>`, which receives `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and the state attributes, so the rendered DOM matches React's `<button aria-expanded>` (RFC 0033 D24). Put it inside a heading.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Marks the item disabled: the button stays focusable but never toggles, and the arrow keys skip it.

api.description: `<primitiv-accordion-content>` — an item's panel. Structural: the root writes its ARIA and hides it while the item is closed.

attributes.name: force-mount
attributes.description: Never sets `hidden`, so styles can animate the panel open and closed. A closed panel always carries `aria-hidden`, so it stays out of the accessibility tree either way.

events.name: primitiv-accordion-show
events.description: Bubbles from the panel as its item opens (not on first render), so a lazy panel can fetch its content.

api.description: `<primitiv-accordion-trigger-icon>` — a decorative indicator inside the trigger's button. The root hides it from assistive technology and mirrors its item's `data-state`, for a chevron that flips.
